quest.title: Only Half-Frozen
quest.description: Despite being well on the way towards freezing to death, Tommy the adventurer is concerned about one thing only: his incomplete commission...

dialogues.speaker: Tommy
dialogues.text: T—Traveler... Could... could you h—help me...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's wrong with you...

dialogues.speaker: Tommy
dialogues.text: P—Please... I—I need some warmth... It's... t—too cold...

dialogues.speaker: Tommy
dialogues.text: O—Or maybe... s—some hot food might also be g—good.

dialogues.speaker: Tommy
dialogues.text: P—Please... I'm just... too c—cold...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I can help you find a heat source.

dialogues.speaker: Tommy
dialogues.text: That's good... That's good. P—Please, hurry... I—I feel like I might freeze any m—moment now...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll make you a hot meal.

dialogues.speaker: Tommy
dialogues.text: That... also works. P—Please, hurry... I—I feel like I might freeze any m—moment now...

talks.objective: Help Tommy find a source of heat

dialogues.speaker: Tommy
dialogues.text: Phew... Much better. Thank you, Traveler.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What brings you to this place?

dialogues.speaker: Tommy
dialogues.text: *sigh* A commission, what else? I've been at the camp all this time because of a rather... tricky commission.

dialogues.speaker: Tommy
dialogues.text: But I didn't want to stay there forever, so I was looking for something else to do...

dialogues.speaker: Tommy
dialogues.text: The chef, Harris, was looking for someone to find some Chilled Meat up the mountain.

dialogues.speaker: Tommy
dialogues.text: He said that I just needed to find some small frozen boar, and that there was no need to go too far up the mountain, so there'd be no danger at all...

dialogues.speaker: Tommy
dialogues.text: I thought it sounded straightforward enough, so I accepted the commission.

dialogues.speaker: Tommy
dialogues.text: I'd been preparing myself, too — training myself slowly, acclimatizing myself to Dragonspine's environment...

dialogues.speaker: Tommy
dialogues.text: ...All so that I might finish the commission given to me by that alchemist lady.

dialogues.speaker: Tommy
dialogues.text: But I didn't expect that I'd lose my way not long after I started my ascent, and nearly get frozen in the process. I was lucky to have met you...

dialogues.speaker: Tommy
dialogues.text: My only regret is that... I couldn't complete my commission...

dialogues.speaker: Tommy
dialogues.text: Traveler... you seem to know this mountain well. Could I trouble you to do me a favor?

dialogues.speaker: Tommy
dialogues.text: I just need you to find me one serving of Chilled Meat. Just one is fine — that is all I need to complete my commission.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got your back.

dialogues.speaker: Tommy
dialogues.text: Thanks. In that case, let me mark the locations where Harris mentioned we might find small frozen boars on your map.

dialogues.speaker: Tommy
dialogues.text: I'll head down to the camp at the base of the mountain and await your good news there.

talks.objective: Make Tommy a serving of Delicious Radish Veggie Soup

dialogues.speaker: Tommy
dialogues.text: Have you found any Chilled Meat?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Got it right here.

dialogues.speaker: Tommy
dialogues.text: Great! So, this is Chilled Meat? Honestly, I don't really see the difference, besides the fact that it's cold to the touch...

dialogues.speaker: Tommy
dialogues.text: Well, so long as the commission's complete...

dialogues.speaker: Tommy
dialogues.text: Thanks, Traveler. I'd have been in a bad way if it hadn't been for you.

dialogues.speaker: Tommy
dialogues.text: Here, you must take this as compensation.

talks.objective: Give the serving of Delicious Radish Veggie Soup to Tommy

dialogues.speaker: Tommy
dialogues.text: H—Have you... found a heat source yet? I d—don't think I can... t—take much more...

talks.objective: Give the Chilled Meat to Tommy

dialogues.speaker: Tommy
dialogues.text: This warmth... I—It must be... R—Radish Veggie Soup!

dialogues.speaker: Tommy
dialogues.text: P—Please... Give me a taste...

dialogues.speaker: Tommy
dialogues.text: H—Have you... finished making that dish yet? I d—don't think I can... t—take much more...

dialogues.speaker: Tommy
dialogues.text: So much effort for a chunk of Chilled Meat... Why could he possibly need it so badly?
